'''1999 Decipher World Championship ECC Sealed''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck (unofficial) held in Virginia Beach, Virginia on 13 November 1999. It is known from Matt Lush's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d110">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-16-day-one-world-championshipsd110/ day-one-world-championships], DeckTech (Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, 16 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-16-day-one-world-championshipsd110/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]].

* '''Date:''' 13 November 1999
* '''Site:''' Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Winner:''' 
* '''Format:''' sealed deck with [[Enhanced Cloud City]] packs (unofficial; played before Enhanced Cloud City's December 1999 release)<ref name="tr-d110" /><ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com:80/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Sunday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com:80/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], Players Committee (Official Tournament Sealed Deck "Released: May 1998", p. 30; Enhanced Premiere "Released: November 1998", p. 22; Enhanced Cloud City "Released: December 1999", p. 23). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

== Discrepancies ==

Where sources disagree, this page keeps the best-supported record and notes the difference here.

* Decipher's DecipherCon 1999 schedule lists an official SW.20 'Enhanced Sealed Deck (ECC+EPP)' on Saturday 13 November (11am–5pm) and Sunday 14 November (1pm–7pm); Lush describes his event as unofficial and late Saturday night, so it may be a separate event.<ref name="tr-d110" />
